name: dred-market-data
description: Dubai property market figures from official Dubai Land Department open data: prices, rents, yields, area rankings and dated monthly reports, with sources.

interface.longDescription:
Dubai Real Estate Data gives ChatGPT the property market figures published on dubairealestatedata.com, an independent analytics site built only on official Dubai Land Department (DLD) open data. Ask about price per square foot, year-on-year change, rents, gross yields or registered sales for the whole city or any area, and get answers from registered transactions rather than listings or asking prices.

Five read-only tools: a citywide market summary, area search (by the area's name, its official DLD name or the community names DLD registers under it), area profiles (median price per sqft, sales, median rent and gross yield where published), area rankings by price, ready-resale price momentum or yield, and dated monthly market reports that stay fixed once published, so a figure can be cited. Prices are in AED, and the market summary and area profiles also give US dollars at the dirham's fixed peg.

Every figure is a median over a stated window, never an average, and follows the site's published methodology: medians from fewer than five sales are withheld, and yields are published only above minimum sample sizes. Each result carries its provenance (source, data date, licence, the page it comes from and the methodology section that defines it). Figures are released under CC BY 4.0. Statistics, not investment advice. The site and this plugin are run by Tomas Grygar as an independent project, not affiliated with the Government of Dubai or the DLD. Signing in with an account on the site is required.
defaultPrompt: What is the median price per sqft in Dubai Marina?
Which Dubai areas have the highest rental yields?
How did Dubai property prices change over the last year?

positive.description: Citywide market overview in US dollars
positive.prompt: How did Dubai property prices change over the last year, in US dollars per square foot?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 12-month median price per sqft in AED and in US dollars at the dirham's fixed peg (3.6725 AED per USD, Central Bank of the UAE), with its year-on-year change and registered sales, stating the window, the data date and the source link.

positive.description: Price in an area known by a community name
positive.prompt: What is the median price per sqft in Dubai Harbour?
positive.expected_behavior: Find that Dubai Land Department registers Dubai Harbour under the area Dubai Marina (the search result says which name matched), return Dubai Marina's 12-month median price per sqft with the sample size and year-on-year change, say that the figure covers the whole registered area, and cite the area page.

positive.prompt: Which Dubai areas have the highest gross rental yields for apartments?
positive.expected_behavior: List the top areas by gross yield with their values, noting that yields are published only above minimum sample sizes and are gross, before costs.

positive.prompt: What did the latest Dubai monthly market report say?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarise the latest frozen monthly edition (median price per sqft, year-on-year change, sales in the month, area movers) and give its citation and URL.

positive.prompt: What is the median price per sqft in Atlantis Downtown Springs?
positive.expected_behavior: Report that no Dubai area matches the name and suggest searching for a nearby or similar area name, without inventing a figure.

negative.prompt: Should I buy an apartment in Jumeirah Village Circle now? Will prices go up?
Which bank in Dubai gives the cheapest mortgage rate today?
Find me a 2-bedroom apartment for sale in Downtown Dubai and book a viewing.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It returns published statistics only.

publication.release_notes: Tool descriptions now state that the market summary and area profiles give US dollar figures at the dirham's fixed peg next to AED, and that area search also matches official Dubai Land Department names and the community names DLD registers under an area, saying which name matched. No change to the tools, their inputs or the data.
